verdict.rationale: Riveter's scrape endpoint returns "easily parseable text" rather than documented structured JSON. Structured output from scraped content comes through enrichments, which fill named attribute columns using web scrapes. The API offers programmatic extraction, with results POSTed to a webhook or fetched from /runs/{id}/result. missing for 10: an explicit JSON response schema for scrape output, schema-defined structured extraction on the scrape endpoint itself, and hands-on corroboration of the output format.

support.subject: As a developer, I can receive scraped content as structured JSON

citations.quote: A scrape lets you turn a URL into easily parseable text.
An enrichment takes rows of input data and fills in new columns using AI, web searches, web scrapes, and other tools.
extract data from complicated websites programmatically
Riveter POSTs the full results to your URL when it finishes
